verified_behaviors: AT global commit applies the order insert and the stock deduction together
AT failure after deduction restores stock and removes the order row through undo_log
AT rollback path clears its own undo_log rows
Committed undo_log rows are removed by the RM async worker (observed about 10s later, test polls up to 30s)
TCC try freezes stock and writes a TRY reservation
TCC confirm consumes the frozen stock and marks the reservation CONFIRMED
TCC cancel releases the frozen stock and marks the reservation CANCELLED
TCC second phase is idempotent thanks to conditional TRY -> CONFIRMED/CANCELLED updates
notes: Seata 2.6 requires @LocalTCC on the action bean, otherwise the branch is never registered with the coordinator
Jackson undo log parser needs jackson-databind plus jackson-datatype-jsr310
undo_log must exist before Spring starts because the datasource proxy validates it eagerly
limitations: Single datasource; cross-database branches not exercised
No TC crash, branch retry or hanging-transaction fault injection
undo_log cleanup after commit is asynchronous, so tests observe it with a bounded wait rather than instantly
TCC idempotency uses conditional updates rather than the Seata TCC fence table
